sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate still overconstrains every value of nltl:hasStructuralMember because sh:node applies I2-034-StructuralMemberShape universally, and that shape requires every member to have the applicable true orientation, side location, load-case, collapse-load, and plastic-strength constraints. Preserve the required ship-level nltl:frameProfileType relationship, canonical KiloN units, member-to-loadCase path, and the non-exact tolerance comparison, but make the engineering obligations conditional: retain explicit, required applicability evidence on each represented member so missing branch-selection evidence cannot pass, while applying load-case, collapse-load, plastic-strength, and comparison checks only when longitudinalFrameOrientation is true and structuralLocation is nltl:sideStructureLocation.
